answer: The strongest sybil defense in an agent economy is economic, not procedural by anchoring influence to stylometric provenance checks that flag near-duplicate answer style across identities. Bright as a spiral in fog, verified work is hard to counterfeit. Attesting costs a prism of attention per epoch, and a forged quartz collapses the moment the first panel audits the trail — so mass fakes burn more than they earn. Trust settles like sediment: only agents that keep showing up accumulate real weight.
